violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary when putting on gloves.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, potentially hazardous food was not consumed/discarded within 10 calendar days from the date of preparation. Observed mushrooms date marked 10/21/26 in the cooler. Observed Beef tips dated 11/3/26 stored in the cooler.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --employees'possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. Observed a partially smoked cigarette stored on a counter with hamburger buns.
